title: Squarespace API keys
snippet:
An application programming interface (API) lets developers build integrations and applications that can connect to your Squarespace site.

> The Squarespace API has the following availability. To learn more, visit [Choosing the right Squarespace plan](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/206536797):
>
> - **Forms API (for Zapier integration)** is available on Core, Plus, Advanced, Business, Commerce Basic, and Commerce Advanced plans.
> - **Orders API** is available in the Core, Plus, Advanced, and Commerce Advanced plan.
> - **Inventory API** is available in the Core, Plus, Advanced, and Commerce Advanced plan.
> - **Transactions API** is available in the Core, Plus, Advanced, and Commerce Advanced plan.

title: Squarespace Pricing & API Plans | APIs.io
snippet:
Squarespace Plans Pricing is the pricing profile for [Squarespace](https://apis.io/providers/squarespace/) on the [APIs.io](https://apis.io/) network — every figure transcribed verbatim from the provider’s own pricing page on 2026-10-28.
It defines 4 plans, including *Basic* — $25 /mo; *Core* — $39 /mo; *Plus* — $65 /mo, and 1 more.
The page prices the business product the API comes with, not the API alone, as a tiered subscription; the service is delivered as managed.

Compare tiers
| Plan | Price | Includes | Overage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | $25 /mo per site | 2 contributors, AI credits 10 (one-time), 2% online store transaction fee, card rates from 2.9% + $0.30; annual price $19 /mo | — |
| Core | $39 /mo per site | Unlimited contributors, AI credits 20 / mo, no online store transaction fees, card rates from 2.9% + $0.30; annual price $29 /mo | — |
| Plus | $65 /mo per site | AI credits 40 / mo, card rates from 2.7% + $0.30; annual price $49 /mo | — |
| Advanced | $139 /mo per site | AI credits 120 / mo, card rates from 2.5% + $0.30, high-traffic checkout; annual price $99 /mo | — |

title: Developer Tools
snippet:
| **Developer API Keys** | Use developer API keys to build integrations with other software. To learn more, visit [Squarespace API Keys](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/236297987). The Squarespace API is a premium feature: - **Forms API** (for Zapier integration) is available on Business and Commerce plans. - **Orders API** is available in the Commerce Advanced plan.

| **Developer mode (**[**version 7.0**](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/115005308187)** only)** | Enable developer mode to build a custom template using custom code. To learn more about the Developer Platform, visit our [developer documentation](http://developers.squarespace.com). Developer mode is a [premium feature](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/115015517328). > **Note**: Switching to developer mode replaces your current template with an editable developer template. You'll edit your developer template with a source-code editor and a connection to Github. **In addition, your template will no longer receive updates and bug fixes added by our team.** |
